I find my self in situations where it is my insecurities holding me back. Is getting over them as simple as telling yourself too. Or Would I have a better chance practicing some exercise before the situations occur. So I would be ready for them. Please help!
How do you realize and get over your insecurities?

I have an easy trick. If I am scared, then I will do it because I do not accept to be scared. If you repeat this enough then you train yourself in not being scared anymore. The first times you will fail, but that is OK because this way you learn to deal with failure gracefully.

Of course you also use your brain, and not do stupid things that will get you jailed or killed.

I used to stress out over normal things. You know, tests, job interviews, meeting new people, whatever. In the end, I just let go. Whatever happens, happens and it doesn't really matter. Tomorrow will come and I'll make the best of it regardless of what happened yesterday. Your heart still beats, you have food in your belly and two feet beneath you. Make the best of what you have and what you have to work with, not what could be.

Some thoughts that help me get over insecurity:

You'll never know whether or not you'll be successful until you try.

Yes, if you try, you may fail, but that's not that bad. Society pressures us to be perfect and not make mistakes when really we should be making mistakes, trying new things and learning from our experiences.

And imagine how much stronger you'll be after making lots of mistakes and getting past them.

Some of the greatest people must've faced massive insecurities, doubts and fears that resulted from having such high goals. "You'll never be the President" or "You'll never be able to invent that" or simply "You won't be that great. The odds are against you." But did that stop them? No! They went on and made history by having that goal and having the determination to see it through.

/end speech. Hopefully that was helpful for you.

My basic strategy is to treat insecurity like working out. If I can voluntarily put myself into situations that make me feel insecure or uncomfortable, little by little I get better at handling said situations.

Check out The Willpower Instinct: http://www.amazon.ca/The-Willpower-Instinct-Self-Control-Matters/dp/1583335080
Nihilism. If you convince yourself nothing matters, it's a lot harder to get hung up on things like your awkward social graces or physical shortcomings.

I have anxiety, and my last anxiety attack happened while on the bus going to a therapist near downtown at about 2pm on a tuesday. I cared so much what the people around me thought I started sweating, couldnt hear anything, felt like I was gonna pass out and die and suffocate all at once. And you know who rides the bus at 2 pm on a tuesday towards DT? Grown ass losers with no job, no money, no car, and nothing to do, yet I cared so much what they thought I had a panic attack.

So I decided to stop caring what people thought of me, and ta-da all was fine and all my problems went away. Until about a week later I was walking through the mall and thought "I wonder if people realize I dont care what they think of me". And "Am I wearing the right thing that tells them I dont care? If I dress too good then it shows I care, but I cant dress bad on purpose either". I had realized I hadnt actually stopped caring what people thought of me, I was just telling myself that.

In order to stop caring about what people thought of me, I had to learn to do things that I wanted to do, and not let my decision making be influenced based on others perception of myself. Wear clothes I felt comfortable in, and dress well not for others, but because I like to dress that way. Its not easy, and will take some time and self critiquing (i.e. why am I doing this? Am I doing this for myself or for others?) but eventually you can learn to care less about others opinions, and focus more on what you want to do, and what you should do.
By owning your imperfections and learning to accept others for theirs.
You have to realize nobody gives a fuuuuuck about you. You're not special, no one's paying attention. With that in mind, go out into the world, and just relax.
